offering_description.value: Manufactures and markets branded packaged foods for grocery retailers, food distributors and foodservice customers.

primary_products.value: Spices and seasonings; baking ingredients; hot cereals; canned foods; frozen foods; sauces and spreads

items.detail: Grocery retailers, mass merchants, warehouse clubs, food distributors and foodservice businesses.

end_markets.value: Consumer packaged foods; grocery retail; foodservice

items.detail: Sales of packaged foods to retailers, distributors and foodservice customers.
Processes agricultural ingredients into packaged foods sold to retailers and food distributors.
Markets food brands, including products made by outside contract manufacturers.

geography_served.detail: Primarily serves the United States, Canada and Puerto Rico.

company_size.value: Large packaged food producer with manufacturing facilities across the United States, a broad brand portfolio and national retail distribution.

specialization.detail: Packaged food categories sharing grocery and foodservice channels, including seasonings, baking ingredients, cereals and prepared foods.

items.detail: Sells directly to major retail and foodservice accounts.
Food wholesalers and distributors supply retail and foodservice customers.
Supermarkets, mass merchants and warehouse clubs sell its packaged foods to consumers.
Independent food brokers help sell products to retail and wholesale accounts.

regulatory_exposure.detail: Food production is subject to FDA food safety, labeling and preventive control rules, along with workplace safety and environmental requirements.
